issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Issuer ID dell'API Key (App Store Connect).

key_id.title: Key ID
key_id.description: Key ID dell'API Key (App Store Connect).

private_key.title: Private Key
private_key.description: Contenuto del file .p8 della API Key. Incollalo così com'è, oppure con \n al posto dei newline.

app_ids.title: App IDs (opzionale)
app_ids.description: Lista di App ID per limitare gli stream dipendenti dalle app. Se vuoto/non presente, vengono lette tutte le app disponibili.

limit.title: Page size
limit.description: Numero massimo di record per pagina (limit).

vendor_number.title: Vendor Number (Sales & Trends)
vendor_number.description: Vendor number per scaricare Sales and Trends reports (filter[vendorNumber]).

sales_frequency.title: Sales frequency
sales_frequency.description: Valore per filter[frequency] in /v1/salesReports (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY).

sales_report_type.title: Sales reportType
sales_report_type.description: Valore per filter[reportType] in /v1/salesReports (es. SALES, SUBSCRIPTION, INSTALLS, ...).

sales_report_sub_type.title: Sales reportSubType
sales_report_sub_type.description: Valore per filter[reportSubType] in /v1/salesReports (es. SUMMARY, DETAILED, ...).

sales_start_date.title: Sales start date
sales_start_date.description: Data iniziale (YYYY-MM-DD) per scaricare i report DAILY.

sales_end_date.title: Sales end date
sales_end_date.description: Data finale (YYYY-MM-DD) per scaricare i report DAILY.

analytics_access_type.title: Analytics accessType
analytics_access_type.description: Tipo di richiesta Analytics (ONGOING o ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT).

analytics_auto_create_requests.title: Analytics auto-create requests
analytics_auto_create_requests.description: Se true e non esiste una Analytics Report Request per l'app, prova a crearla (richiede ruolo Admin).

analytics_categories.title: Analytics categories (opzionale)
analytics_categories.description: Filtro per filter[category] (APP_USAGE, APP_STORE_ENGAGEMENT, COMMERCE, FRAMEWORK_USAGE, PERFORMANCE).

analytics_granularity.title: Analytics granularity
analytics_granularity.description: Filtro per filter[granularity] in /v1/analyticsReports/{id}/instances (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY).

analytics_start_date.title: Analytics start date
analytics_start_date.description: Data iniziale (YYYY-MM-DD) per filtrare processingDate delle istanze.

analytics_end_date.title: Analytics end date
analytics_end_date.description: Data finale (YYYY-MM-DD) per filtrare processingDate delle istanze.
